purpose.summary: A menu-driven batch/interactive program (PROGRAM-ID: modelo) that manages a customer portfolio for salespeople. It supports CRUD operations on client and vendor indexed files, import of client data from sequential files, report generation, and a client distribution function. The program is written in Brazilian Portuguese and uses geolocation coordinates.

notable_features: Indexed files with alternate keys (CNPJ, CPF)
LOCK MODE IS MANUAL on indexed files
VALUE OF FILE-ID for dynamic file naming
COPY statement for CGC/CPF validation routine
Geolocation fields (Latitude, Longitude) on client and vendor records
